admission.justification: Hide-behind-launcher needs both the rail panel wrapper and its state hook; typed per-case proofs were withdrawn as extractor-unsupported.

applicability: Selections with no effective agent, including no selected document with and without a matching Projects Architect.
conditions: A matching unarchived Projects Architect counts as an effective agent target.
exclusions: Agent-bearing selections, which take the message-switch path.

evidence: sidebarChatStaysLoaded.test.tsx (ghost keeps element behind aria-hidden wrapper; return switches back) + model.ts documentChatBinding/documentChatAgent (unchanged)

statement: Where the selection has no effective agent the frame is hidden and stays loaded with the bound launcher or problem text shown, and a returning agent selection switches back in the same frame.
